findings.title: Missing recheck after write lock causes cache stampede and can clobber a valid cache
findings.body: After the initial RLock snapshot, the function may see a nil cache and move to the write lock, but it does not re-read entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring that lock. In non-development mode, multiple callers that saw nil on first request can serialize on the write lock and each rebuild the manifest. Worse, if a later rebuild fails, line 69 assigns entryPointAssetsCache = nil, overwriting a valid cache installed by the first caller with nil. Re-check the cache under the write lock in non-dev mode and return the existing value, and avoid replacing an existing valid cache with nil on an error.
